title: Which country has emitted the most CO₂ since 1750?
subtitle: Rank five countries by all the CO₂ they have ever emitted, then rewind to 1850 to see who started it all, as two hosts argue it out.
form: rank cards (drag into order); dialogue: b is the skeptic who dismisses Britain
notes: Review fixes: guess highlight on all cards kept (b names both ends); 'Germany' card shortened to GER so it fits at size 2; ending ring replaced by highlight; 1800 '99%' said as 'nearly all the CO₂ on record' (records before ~1830 cover almost only Britain); 1911 label beside the USA bar. Engine gaps: ylim cannot be animated (wanted 0-30 for 2024 then 0-80 for 1850), so 2024 bars stay short; a rank reveal does not mark which of the viewer's cards were right; rank cards are small unless size 2.
